Purpose and Need:
Enclosed for your review and consideration is the22905Agreement between the

Corridor Rail Crossing Elimination Project aspart of the Federal Railroad
Administration'sFY23-24Railroad Crossing Elimination Program.As outlined in
federal statute(49 USC522905), the City must enter into a formal agreement with
BNSF Railway, the owner of the affected rail corridor, to obtain necessary rights and
permissions for project development, final design, andfuture construction activities.
The safety components for the project intend to:
Improve safety by eliminating multipleat-grade crossings.
Upgrade remaining crossings with pedestrian safety devices and
channel iz ation.
Restrict accessto therailroad through new corridor fencing.

corridor.

funds.
